master_bugs.BUG-001: Radeon™ Super Resolution may fail to trigger after changing resolution or HDR settings on games such as Nioh™ 2.
master_bugs.BUG-002: Vertical Refresh Sync set globally to Always Off may cause system stuttering or driver timeout during video playback using Radeon™ RX 6000 series GPUs.
master_bugs.BUG-003: Driver timeout may occur using HEVC hardware encoding on Radeon™ RX 6000 series GPUs.
master_bugs.BUG-004: Dropped frames may occur during video playback using hardware acceleration on Chromium-based browsers with Radeon™ RX 6000 series GPUs.
master_bugs.BUG-005: Chromium-based browsers may experience video stuttering on extended monitors with mixed refresh rates using Radeon™ RX 6000 series GPUs.
master_bugs.BUG-006: Oculus dashboard menu and rendered controllers may appear bouncing/wobbly on Oculus Quest 2 with some AMD Graphics Products such as the Radeon™ RX 6800 XT Graphics.
master_bugs.BUG-007: While previewing the timeline in VEGAS Pro™, some colors may appear inverted.
master_bugs.BUG-008: GPU utilization may be stuck at 100% in Radeon performance metrics after closing games on some AMD Graphics Products such as Radeon™ 570.
master_bugs.BUG-009: When Radeon™ Anti-Lag is enabled, a beep can be heard when pressing shift + back key.
master_bugs.BUG-010: Elite Dangerous may crash upon launch on Radeon™ RX 6000 series GPUs.
master_bugs.BUG-011: Stuttering may occur during video playback using hardware acceleration with Firefox on some AMD Graphics Products such as the Radeon™ RX 6900 XT Graphics.
master_bugs.BUG-012: Brief display corruption may occur when switching between video and game windows on some AMD Graphics Products such as the Radeon™ RX 6700 XT.
